title: How to Manage Commissions for Partners and Real Estate Agents
summary: See how to structure and automate commission calculations for partners and real estate agents.
body_markdown:
Managing commissions for partners and real estate agents means each booking or lease connects to the agent responsible, with commission calculated automatically based on defined rules — instead of a manual spreadsheet calculation prone to disputes. In **Jestor** , this uses the same commission calculation structure applied to sales teams generally.


Commission disputes are one of the more damaging things that can happen in a partner or agent relationship, and they almost always trace back to unclear or manually miscalculated splits.


## What manual commission tracking risks


- Manual calculation errors leading to disputes with partners or agents
- No clear connection between a specific booking and the commission it generated
- Inconsistent commission rules applied differently across different agents
- Delayed commission payouts because calculation happens only periodically, manually


## How automated commission management works


- Each booking or lease connects to the responsible agent or partner
- Commission rules calculate automatically based on defined rates or tiers
- Approved commissions post directly into **Omie** or **Conta Azul** as payables
- Agents can be given scoped visibility into their own commission history


## Why Jestor fits this use case


- Commission calculation connects directly to the booking generating it, reducing disputes
- Automated calculation removes manual arithmetic errors
- Native ERP integration handles commission payables without manual re-entry
- Scoped permissions let agents track their own performance and payouts


Manual commission tracking Automated commission management


Manual calculation, dispute-prone Automatic, rule-based calculation

## Frequently Asked Questions


**Can commission rates vary by agent or partner tier?** Yes, rules can be configured for different rates or tiers. More at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Do approved commissions post automatically to the ERP?** Yes, through native Omie or Conta Azul integration.


**Can agents see their own commission history?** Yes, through scoped permissions limited to their own data.
